name: vigil
title: Home Monitor Matrix
description: Manage local camera feeds, control hardware relays, view real solar/security telemetry, and scan your LAN for Tasmota/Shelly/ESPHome devices to bring under control.
notes: Smart-home hardware (Tasmota/Shelly/ESPHome/Zigbee2MQTT devices) is optional -- Vigil runs and discovers devices over the LAN without any of it, but relay control obviously needs real devices to control.
